summary: Row 62: the keyword tokenizer allowed Devanagari, Bengali and Arabic combining marks only, so Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Gurmukhi, Odia, Myanmar and Khmer keywords were cut at vowel signs and viramas (bbc Tamil's top keyword was அவர for அவர்); _WORD_RE now continues a word through every Mn/Mc/Me mark (R690(1)'s rule), and km/lo/my/bo, space-less with no segmenter, are reported unsegmented. Row 63: the report's first cause was wrong (Bengali digit years already parse); the miss was the year-FIRST form ১৯৭১ সালের ২৫ মার্চ, now read (a refused year still claims the span so no guess replaces it). R727: year-less dates resolve within 183 days before / 92 after publication, else nothing; every anchor-resolved tag carries :year-inferred in its extractor provenance (no new column) and the reader, the Agenda's deduced events (n_year_inferred) and the mentions dialog show it; only a recorded publication date not later than the day after storage anchors (publication_anchor), on every path (inline store, pooled re-index, ingest precompute, month occupancy, date diagnostics, reader fallback). Keyword engine bumped to 4: a re-extraction follows. Not reproduced on main: '১১ মিলিয়ন' -> 11 May.
